boxes.name: 3-corridor

Corridor width is 121.533 per the recorded refinement, so B's sliver lon 121.533-121.535 x lat 25.055-25.060 (~0.1 km2) leaves the tile — see the phase-1 evidence for what was in it.

boxes.name: 4-beitou

boxes.name: 5-incinerator
boxes.note: Connector (issue #102): covers the Beitou Incinerator (25.1079, 121.4990) in the notch between the corridor (west edge 121.503) and Box 4 (south edge 25.113); shares an edge with both.

comment: Tile definition for the Taipei tile (issues #60, #102): the tile is the UNION of the rectangles in `boxes`. Every pipeline stage reads this file — extract-from-pbf.py collects any OSM element touching a box (keyed by OSM id, so a way crossing a seam is collected once, whole), and the builders clip geometry against the union of the world-frame box rects. Adding a box is a config change here, not new code. Phase history: A+B (issue #60, B absorbed into 3-corridor in #102); S + 3-corridor + 4-beitou + 5-incinerator added in issue #102 (northern phase 1, data only — the iconic northern buildings are phase 2).
